key_idea: The box has just one layer, so from above each cube is one red square. Turn the box in your head to line it up.
steps: The box has 9 spaces in one layer. 6 have a red cube. The middle space, the right corner and the space in front of the right corner are empty.
Turn the box in your head so the front left side is at the bottom. It has 3 cubes in a row, so the bottom row is red, red, red.
The back left side is now on the left. It also has 3 cubes, so the left column is all red.
The back right side has 2 cubes and then the empty corner, so the top row is red, red, white. The middle row is red, white, white. That is picture D.

choice_feedback.A: This is a mirror picture of the box. Turning the box cannot make it look like this.
choice_feedback.B: This has a red square in the middle, but the middle space of the box is empty.
choice_feedback.C: This is a mirror picture of the box. Turning the box cannot make it look like this.
choice_feedback.E: This has a red square in the middle, but the middle space of the box is empty.
